measure: random subsamples reproducing the transmembrane anomaly

verdict: SALINITY DOES NOT ACCOUNT FOR THE ASSOCIATION - it removes 1% of the coefficient and does not predict ph_min at all (p 3.57e-01). The matched transmembrane control does fire on this subsample (-0.14768, p 3.00e-03, 1.06x the periplasmic coefficient against 0.23x on the full sample), and that is NOT ordinary subsample noise (2.0% of random quarters go as far), so genomes with a salinity measurement carry a transmembrane signal that salinity itself does not explain - an open question this script raises and does not settle.
